dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth and symmetrical 2D reduction in body width from the maximum breadth at the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are largely symmetrical with no significant localized asymmetrical bulges or indentations visible.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel reflectance across the entire visible dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast dark elliptical feature (blowhole) at the anterior; faint, low-contrast diagonal linear marks visible mid-dorsally.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge visible as a shadow-casting raised feature along the posterior midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple faint, parallel healed linear marks (rake marks) across the central dorsal plane.
